Right, so you have three options here. This one is the newest and it is the fastest board in the shop, no question. It is also the hardest one to surf and it has the least volume, so on a small day you are going to hate it. This second one is secondhand, it is only two years old, and it is half the price. Honestly, it is better value than anything else on this wall. And the third one is the most expensive board we have. It is the best board in the shop, I am not going to pretend otherwise, but for six months? It is not worth it, mate. Buy the secondhand one and spend the rest on the bus.

Okay, two options. The town beach is closer, it is ten minutes on foot, and that is the only good thing about it, because it is the most crowded beach on this whole coast. The other one is forty minutes on the bus. The waves there are much better and it is a lot emptier, so yes, the trip is worth it. One warning though. It is a reef, not a beach break. On a small day it is the best wave around here. On a big day it is more dangerous than anything you have surfed at home, so go with somebody the first time.
